method: Windows built-in OCR (original and 2x LANCZOS upscale, coordinates halved) on the stored (insignia-removed) image; OCR lines split where the word gap exceeds 1.2x the text height; boxes from both scales with IoU > 0.25 unioned and padded 3 px. OCR found every printed line at one scale or the other (29 lines; 'Generate Li', 'Fuselage Body)' and 'Hold Things ogether' were read short, but their boxes already span the whole printed line), so no box was added by hand; checked by eye on a filled-cover overlay and a zoomed per-box contact sheet (2026-11-02, docs/evidence/sam-figure-candidates/labels-nasa-grc-airplane-parts-1*.jpg). No SAM concept prompts (no live calls). One group per printed label: a part name and the red function line(s) printed under it share a group (e.g. group 5 = 'Wing' + 'Generate Lift'). Only the part-name line carries `text`; the function lines carry no `text` because a group's texts are joined into the one printed label that LD-02/LD-10 check and that the worker sends to Muse ('Wing Generate Lift' would read as the page word 'lift'). Their printed words, top to bottom per group: 1 'Control Yaw'; 2 'Change Yaw' '(Side-to-Side)'; 3 'Control Pitch'; 4 'Change Pitch' '(Up-Down)'; 5 'Generate Lift'; 6 'Change Lift and Drag'; 7 'Generate Thrust'; 8 'Change Roll' '(Rotate Body)'; 9 'Change Lift and Drag' '(Rotate Body)'; 10 'Command and Control'; 11 'Hold Things Together' '(Carry Payload - Fuel)'; 12 'Change Lift'. Leader arrows are not labels and are not covered.
partLabelGroupsNote: Lead-curated (SAM figure candidates, 2026-11-02): label groups that name drawn parts, kept only when the page text names the label (whole, or by its last word: the LD-10 rule) AND SAM 3.1 was sure of the part in the probe (>= 0.73, docs/evidence/sam-figure-candidates/result.json): Vertical Stabilizer (group 1, 0.88), Horizontal Stabilizer (3, 0.86), Wing (5, 0.96), Flaps (6, 0.76), Aileron (8, 0.89). Left out: Jet Engine (7, SAM 0.73): the page only says 'jet engines' and 'turbine engines' (plural), and the page-wording rule matches whole words without plural folding, so the label counts as not named; Fuselage (Body) (11, 0.78): SAM's box covered the whole airplane, not the fuselage alone. Rudder (2, 0.67), Elevator (4, 0.47), Spoiler (9, 0.31), Cockpit (10, 0.30) and Slats (12, 0.26) are below 0.73. Aileron (group 8) dropped 2026-11-02 after live runs: the thin wingtip strip got SAM 0.35-0.38 in two of three label-diagram drafts (docs/evidence/sam-figures-live/), so lessons use the four large parts.
